# Graha Remedy

> Free, rule-based Vedic astrology (Jyotish) spiritual remedy platform. Zero AI in chart calculations or remedy mapping; 100% deterministic lookups sourced from classical scriptures.

## Overview
Graha Remedy calculates birth charts (Lagna, Moon sign, planetary degrees, active Vimshottari Mahadasha/Antardasha, and key doshas such as Mangal, Kaal Sarp, Sade Sati) from birth date, time, and coordinates, and matches life challenges (career, health, relationships, finance, education, travel) to authentic classical spiritual remedies.

## Key Capabilities
- **Birth Chart Calculator**: High-precision planetary positions using the Swiss Ephemeris engine.
- **Rule-Based Remedies**: Classical Mantras (Namaha & Beej), Fasting (Vrata), Charity (Daan), and Deity worship.
- **Zero Hallucination**: No generative AI used in chart math or remedy output.
- **100% Free**: No paywalls, no subscriptions, no premium tiers.

## Classical Sources
- *Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra* (Sage Parashara)
- *Phaladeepika* (Mantreswara)
- *Valmiki Ramayana* (Aditya Hridayam, Yuddha Kanda)
- *Markandeya Purana* (Durga Saptashati & Durga Kavach)
- *Atharva Veda* (Ganesha Atharvashirsha)
